children: Hyatt Hotels and Delta Air Lines are starting a new long-term partnership offering loyalty perks to their members.
Eligible members of Delta SkyMiles and the World of Hyatt loyalty program will now be able to earn miles and points, respectively, through both programs.

Hyatt members can earn Hyatt points on qualifying Delta airfare purchases, while SkyMile Medallion members can earn miles for qualifying stays at participating Hyatt properties, the companies said Wednesday.
The partnership will also include exclusive benefit offers and experiences, they said.
Delta and Hyatt said they plan to provide more details about enrollment, eligibility, earning opportunities and launch experiences in the months ahead.
